The dining area flows effortlessly into the family room, which opens to your own private concrete patio —an ideal space for morning coffee, weekend barbecues, or simply unwinding outdoors. The family room opens to a spacious kitchen featuring newer cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, and a convenient breakfast bar, perfect for casual dining and gathering with family and friends.

results.remarks:
Tucked behind the gates of Ontario’s Parkside community, this two-story townhome offers a private, sun-washed courtyard and a bright interior that feels ready for its next chapter. Mediterranean stucco, a clay-tile roof, and a decorative iron balcony set a warm first impression, while a wrought-iron gate opens onto pavers, an easy outdoor room for a grill, a couple of chairs, and weekend gatherings.

Step inside to an open, freshly painted main floor washed in natural light, with light wood-look flooring, recessed lighting, and a living area that flows straight into the kitchen. Dual windows look toward the courtyard, and the kitchen answers with white cabinetry, granite counters, and a center island with a dual sink that doubles as a breakfast bar. Stainless appliances, a gas range, a pantry alcove, and extra cabinet storage keep the space practical and inviting. A powder room with a pedestal sink sits nearby, and the attached two-car garage opens directly into the home.

Upstairs, everyday living is well thought out. A dedicated laundry room and a landing with built-in cabinetry sit just off the bedrooms. Two secondary rooms offer ceiling fans and generous closets, sharing a full hall bath with a tub and shower. The primary suite is the quiet retreat: a spacious walk-in closet and an en-suite with dual vanities, a glass walk-in shower, and a soaking tub set in an arched, window-lit alcove.

Residents enjoy an oversized community pool, clubhouse, fire pit, playground, picnic areas, and a dog park, with Cucamonga-Guasti Regional Park next door for fishing, pedal boats, and water play. Ontario Mills, Victoria Gardens, Costco, and Ontario International Airport are minutes away, and the 10, 15, and 210 freeways are an easy reach along Inland Empire Boulevard. A low tax rate of about 1.1 percent adds lasting value to this move-in-ready home.

Discover contemporary living at its finest in this beautifully appointed tri-level home located in the desirable Park Place community of Ontario Ranch. Offering 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms with no shared walls, this residence combines privacy, comfort, and modern design.
The first floor features a spacious primary suite with its own private sitting area and direct access to a secluded side yard, creating the perfect space for guests, multigenerational living, or a peaceful outdoor retreat.

Just off the dining area, a large private balcony extends your living space outdoors, making it ideal for relaxing or gathering with family and friends.

Every detail has been thoughtfully planned to create an active, convenient, and vibrant place to call home. Conveniently located near Ontario Mills, Victoria Gardens, Ontario International Airport, and major commuter routes, this home places shopping, dining, entertainment, and travel all within easy reach.
